title: Pyne Pod Mango Passionfruit Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Mango Passion Fruit 10ml E-Liquid offers a deeply luscious and vibrant tropical fruit pairing. The profile opens with the thick, syrupy sweetness of ripe Mango, establishing a warm and highly satisfying base. This rich foundation is immediately lifted by the bright, slightly acidic tang of Passion Fruit, providing an exotic contrast that balances the sweetness and delivers a complex, mouth-watering finish. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the exotic warmth of Mango Passion Fruit, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the refreshing Cola Lime, the bold Fizzy Cherry, or the layered sweetness of Mango Strawberry Peach.
